fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Whether you play rugby, netball, hockey, basketball, soccer or martial arts, dental injuries can happen in an instant. A custom-fitted mouthguard is a simple, effective way to help protect your teeth, lips, gums and jaw during sport.

fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: At Precision Dental, we make custom mouthguards for children, teenagers and adults, designed around the shape of your teeth.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Is a Custom Mouthguard?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A custom mouthguard is a protective appliance made from a precise scan or impression of your teeth. Layers of durable, shock-absorbing material are moulded to fit your upper teeth closely, helping spread the force of an impact and reduce the risk of broken teeth, knocked-out teeth and soft tissue injuries.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Compared with over-the-counter or boil-and-bite guards, custom mouthguards typically offer a closer, more secure fit. A comfortable guard is easier to breathe and speak with, which means players are more likely to wear it consistently.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Is a Custom Mouthguard Right for You?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We recommend a mouthguard for anyone who:

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Plays contact or collision sports

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Plays ball sports, including cricket, hockey, basketball or netball

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Participates in martial arts, boxing or skateboarding

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Has crowns, veneers, bridges or implants that need protection

fields.label: List item
fields.value: Wears braces, where specialised guards may be required

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Children's mouths change as teeth grow, so mouthguards for children and teenagers often need replacing more frequently. If you grind your teeth at night, a different appliance known as a night splint is used, which we discuss on our grinding and clenching page. Patients undergoing Invisalign treatment should speak with us about sport protection.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: What Happens at Your Appointment

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Assessment

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We check the teeth and gums to make sure there are no concerns that should be treated before your guard is made. We also discuss your sport, so the thickness and design suit your level of play.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Scan or Impression

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A digital scan or impression records the shape of your teeth accurately. This usually takes only a few minutes.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Choosing Your Design

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: You can select colours to suit your team or personal style.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.value: Fitting

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: When your mouthguard is ready, we check its fit and comfort and explain how to care for it.

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Aftercare and Ongoing Care

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Rinse your mouthguard with cool water before and after use, and clean it gently with a soft toothbrush. Avoid hot water, which can distort the material. Store your guard in a ventilated case, away from direct sunlight and heat, such as a car dashboard. Bring it to your check-ups so we can check its condition. Replace your mouthguard if it becomes worn, damaged or loose, or if your teeth have changed.

sections.label: Why Choose Precision Dental for Mouthguards

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Why Choose Precision Dental for Mouthguards

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We take accurate digital records of your teeth, tailor the design to your sport and check the fit carefully. For growing children, we monitor changes as part of their children's dentistry visits and advise when a replacement is needed.

sections.label: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Fees, Health Funds and Payment Options

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we talk you through your options and the expected fees before any treatment begins. We accept most major health funds, process claims on the spot through HICAPS and are a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Interest-free payment plans are available through DentiCare for eligible patients, subject to terms and conditions. You can learn more on our Prices and Payment Options page.

fields.label: Small label
fields.value: FAQ

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Frequently Asked Questions

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Are custom mouthguards better than store-bought ones?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Custom mouthguards are made to fit your teeth closely, which generally makes them more comfortable and less likely to move during play.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: How often should a mouthguard be replaced?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Adults may need a new guard every year or two, depending on wear. Children and teenagers often need replacements sooner as their teeth develop.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Can I talk and drink with a custom mouthguard?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: A well-fitted guard makes it easier to speak and breathe during play. Most players adjust quickly.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: What if my child has baby teeth and adult teeth?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Mouthguards can be made during this stage, but they may need to be replaced more often as new teeth come through.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Do mouthguards prevent concussion?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Mouthguards are designed to protect the teeth and mouth. Current evidence does not show they prevent concussion.

fields.label: Question
fields.value: Are mouthguards covered by health funds?

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Many extras policies provide rebates for custom mouthguards. We can provide item numbers so you can check with your fund.
